Return a list of output lines, rather than printing them. Preserve leading spaces and use no trailing spaces. n >= 0. Each line has width n: row i=1..n has n-i spaces followed by i stars.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "  *",
    " **",
    "***"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

The spaces and stars together occupy n columns.

Complexity: O(n^2) characters of time and output

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises

solutions.name: right-triangle.py
solutions.code:
def solve(n):
    return [' '*(n-i)+'*'*i for i in range(1,n+1)]
